_readme: Taiwan-Mandarin wording for the `tw` locale, applied before the OpenCC
cn->twp pass in scripts/_hant.mjs. Keys are the *simplified* source strings
(what the Chinese editorial copy contains), values are the form Taiwanese
readers expect. Only list entries where OpenCC's own output is not what
Taiwan uses — everything else is left to OpenCC, so this stays a short list
of deliberate exceptions rather than a second dictionary.
Longest key wins, so a longer name placed here beats a shorter one inside it
(马里兰 is listed before 马里 for exactly that reason).
Applied AFTER OpenCC, to undo its over-reach: OpenCC rewrites both 连接 and
連接 as 連線 (a network link) and both 绑定/綁定 as 繫結, which this site's
text never means. Keep each entry tied to a phrase seen in the corpus — a
bare character swap would break the cases OpenCC gets right (一隻狗, 連線網路).
